name: How each run is going
what: Classifiers that ship with Silo give each run its state: working, waiting on the model, waiting on a command, idle, or stuck. They also mark the stretches of a run as orienting, thrashing or progress. And they point out repeats: the same command, the same install, the same content entering context again.

suggest.why: Silo sees every run from outside, whichever program or app started it, so it is the one place that can tell you a run is stuck or going in circles.
